metadata.title: Emmy Noether: Modern LaTeX Working Corpus and Multilingual Translation Readers
metadata.version: 2026-07-18 R823 multilingual corpus; Paper 4 English through Section 6; Japanese Papers 21 and 23; Korean Paper 29 U01-U04; Chinese Paper 37

metadata.description:
This is the reader-facing Emmy Noether working record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. It contains the current German R823 LaTeX source control; cumulative English, Spanish, French, and Interslavic working readers; bounded components in additional languages; and editable source, provenance, repair, render, and audit material.

Current bounded additions: a complete bounded Japanese working translation of Paper 21 from sealed P31 German lines 12583-12674, and Korean Paper 29 unit U04 from exact lines 47-51. Korean U04 is only one proof-continuation stage; line 52 is blank and line 53 is the next substantive cursor. An append-only correction records the sealed line-53 opening and rejects an inaccurate quote from the transport receipt without changing any U04 artifact.

Machine-readable evidence: the packages retain structural indices, formula/display and note correspondence, terminology and adverse-choice records, append-only difficulty/failure records, evidence graphs, source/control hashes, validation receipts, and exact internal-package bindings. Host-bound paths and workflow labels are projected to logical identifiers.

Visual evidence: all three exact 200-ppi Japanese target pages and three Korean project-generated renders are published with stable IDs, dimensions, DPI, parent hashes, structural links, review states, and publication dispositions. Two Korean source pages are represented by hashes, coordinates, bounding boxes, and rights-blocked dispositions only; their source pixels are not redistributed.

Status caveat: these are substantial machine-assisted working editions, translations, source controls, and review artifacts. Bounded source-audit claims apply only to their stated units. They are not official critical editions, peer review, proof certification, independent human scholarly review, accessibility certification, native-language/community certification, rights determinations, or guarantees that every symbol and translation choice is correct.

GitHub: corrections and improvements can be proposed through issues or pull requests at https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.

additional_descriptions.description: Reader-first multilingual Noether working corpus. This version adds bounded Japanese Paper 21 and Korean Paper 29 U04, with direct editable TeX/PDF files, source and machine evidence, and complete rights-aware visual packages. Japanese P21 has three open target renders. Korean U04 has three open project renders; two source-page witnesses remain metadata-only because redistribution rights are unresolved. U04 ends at line 51 and continues at line 53. The corrected line-53 quote is append-only and does not alter the translation or package hashes. Not a complete Korean Paper 29, critical edition, peer review, proof certification, independent human or native review, accessibility certification, or rights determination.

access_status.description_l10n: The record and files are publicly accessible.
